name: Knight of Xoroth is not offered the Warrior Path of Defense quest and learns none of its spells
contract: Issue #5714: Path of Defense (quest 1498) is Warrior-only: quest_template_addon AllowableClasses = 1 (Warrior), PrevQuestID = 1505, and its RewardSpell 8121 is the wrapper for Defensive Stance, Sunder Armor and Taunt.
Quest 1505 is Warrior-only too, so the prerequisite is rewarded to both characters with the fixture, which bypasses class gating; whether 1498 can then be taken is decided only by the class check.
Expected: the Warrior can take 1498 once 1505 is rewarded, a Knight of Xoroth cannot take it with the same prerequisite and so cannot learn the Warrior spells from it.

steps.label: Fixture: the Warrior has the prerequisite quest
SETUP: the Warrior's prerequisite is rewarded
Warrior can take Path of Defense
Fixture: the Knight has the same prerequisite quest
SETUP: the Knight's prerequisite is rewarded
Knight of Xoroth cannot take Path of Defense
Knight does not know Defensive Stance
Knight does not know Sunder Armor
Knight does not know the Path of Defense wrapper
